events.subtitle: White Stones — world premiere
events.factual_description: Japan Society announces the world premiere of White Stones on December 11, 2026 at 8 PM. The Japanese-American musician and Lakota performance and visual artist bring Japanese drums, flute, koto, voice, violin, electronics and invented instruments into a shared sound world. The presenter describes Kite's Indigenous-centered AI as shaping the performance in real time. Standard nonmember admission is $43; member and disability rates are $32.

en.why_it_matters: Watanabe and Kite place the sound and ritual languages of Noh and Lakota traditions in conversation, with electronics and live computational intervention woven into the performance rather than added as a visual gimmick. This is an unusually specific cross-cultural musical experiment.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for the premiere if a December New York visit is possible. The new work earns A+ without assuming it will never be performed again.
en.listen_before: Watanabe’s Néo is an introduction to his approach to percussion and flute, not a recording of White Stones.

es.why_it_matters: Watanabe y Kite ponen en diálogo las sonoridades y las prácticas rituales del teatro nō y de la tradición lakota. La electrónica y la intervención computacional en vivo forman parte del lenguaje de la obra, no de un simple recurso escénico.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio al estreno si se arma una visita a Nueva York en diciembre. La propuesta amerita A+ sin dar por hecho que no volverá a presentarse.
es.listen_before: Néo permite acercarse al lenguaje de percusión y flauta de Watanabe; no es una grabación de White Stones.

events.subtitle: Dziesmu Kamoliņš / Garland of Songs
lineup: Arta Jēkabsone — voice, piano, violin & electronics
events.factual_description: The Jazz Gallery presents two sets on January 23, 2027 featuring Jēkabsone's folk-rooted project Garland of Songs with an eight-person lineup. The program reworks Latvian songs and dainas through original composition and improvisation. The artist confirms the album was released October 16, 2025; the venue describes this concert as an album premiere, not a new recording release date.

en.why_it_matters: A chamber-sized ensemble with a full string quartet and Keita Ogawa on percussion offers a compelling way to hear Latvian folk poetry and melody transformed through improvisation. The focus is the particular arrangement, rather than a generic folk-jazz crossover.
en.trip_verdict: Worth catching if a New York visit coincides with either set; not a reason to make a separate trip.
en.listen_before: Listen to Dziesmu Kamoliņš to hear the melodies and textures that the live ensemble will reinterpret.

es.why_it_matters: Un cuarteto de cuerdas completo y la percusión de Keita Ogawa dan otra dimensión a las canciones y los versos tradicionales letones que Jēkabsone reelabora mediante la improvisación. El atractivo está en los arreglos concretos de esta formación.
es.trip_verdict: Vale la pena si coincide con una visita a Nueva York; no hace falta organizar un viaje aparte.
es.listen_before: Escucha Dziesmu Kamoliņš para familiarizarte con las melodías y los timbres que retomará la formación en vivo.
